keep.reason: Industrial ink: brass-lit cream text on bottle-green wallpaper, where pure white would read as a screen.
Analog ink: the warm glow of a TV in a dark brown room, as the brand book dresses the era.
Only Atomic and Analog wear it, for rounded TV screens and Formica; every other era is square or nearly so.
The brand book specifies a pill edge for the verdict stamp, part of the fixed chassis.
